name: TC-10-condition-monitoring
description: TC-10.1: Condition Monitoring Full Lifecycle — Active → Warning → Critical → Resolved

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.1 — Condition Monitoring List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Condition Monitoring. This module tracks real-time sensor data and condition indicators for assets, with configurable warning and critical thresholds.

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.1 — New Condition Monitor
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to set up condition monitoring for an asset. Define the monitoring type (Vibration, Temperature, Pressure, etc.), baseline value, and warning/critical thresholds.

steps.value: E2E Test — Vibration monitoring for Test Motor 001

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.1 — Fill Analysis Notes
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test — Vibration monitoring for Test" into the Analysis Notes field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.1 — Condition Monitor Created
doc_metadata.caption: The condition monitoring record is created in 'Active' state. As readings are taken, the system automatically transitions to Warning or Critical states based on threshold values.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the threshold fields and current reading value.

doc_metadata.title: TC-10.1 — Condition Monitoring Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The detail view shows the asset, monitoring type, baseline value, thresholds, current reading, alert status, and trend direction. The workflow state reflects the current alert level.
